As Omega Healthcare Invs (OHI) Stock Value Declined, Advisory Services Network Cut Its Holding by $1.47 Million; Doheny Asset Management Increases Stake in Bank Of America (BAC)
April 29, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Doheny Asset Management increased its stake in Bank Of America Corp (BAC) by 57.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Doheny Asset Management bought 58,890 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 161,270 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.76M, up from 102,380 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Doheny Asset Management who had been investing in Bank Of America Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $306.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.27% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $30.15. About 47.41 million shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 28.18% since April 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.63% the S&P500.
Advisory Services Network Llc decreased its stake in Omega Healthcare Invs Inc (OHI) by 98.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Advisory Services Network Llc sold 54,401 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.90% with the market. The institutional investor held 833 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $23,000, down from 55,234 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Advisory Services Network Llc who had been investing in Omega Healthcare Invs Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.87% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $25.8. About 1.87 million shares traded. Omega Healthcare Investors, Inc. (NYSE:OHI) has declined 18.67% since April 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.22% the S&P500.
Among 33 analysts covering Bank of America ( NYSE:BAC ), 22 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. Bank of America had 114 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Monday, March 26, the company rating was maintained by Oppenheimer. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Thursday, February 16 by Macquarie Research. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Tuesday, January 26 with “Buy”. On Wednesday, November 1 the stock rating was maintained by JP Morgan with “Overweight”. The rating was maintained by CLSA with “Outperform” on Friday, September 23. The stock has “Buy” rating by Nomura on Tuesday, September 8. The rating was maintained by Sandler O’Neill on Tuesday, January 9 with “Buy”. The company was maintained on Tuesday, June 6 by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. The rating was downgraded by UBS to “Neutral” on Wednesday, January 11. The company was maintained on Monday, April 16 by Nomura.
Doheny Asset Management, which manages about $245.55 million and $214.55M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) by 2,250 shares to 41,823 shares, valued at $5.84 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Celgene Corp (NASDAQ:CELG) by 19,780 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 28,595 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
